title: Practice 7: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: На Кубе выращивают много ___ (сахарный) тростника.
exercises.prompt: A lot of sugar cane is grown in Cuba.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «тростника»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The name Canada comes from the Iroquoian word kanata, which means "village" or "settlement".
exercises.ru: Название Канады происходит от ___ слова «каната», означающего «деревня», «поселение».
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «слова»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Что, больше ни у кого нет ___ (кассетный) плееров?
exercises.prompt: What, nobody has cassette players anymore?
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «плееров»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том плюхнулся на диван, измученный после ___ (тяжёлый) рабочего дня.
